en.t: Her voice was tender and pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 柏木未能恣情听赏，匆匆出门而去，

en.t: Kashiwagi could not linger and listen to his heart's content, but hurriedly went out and left,

units.source_text: 似觉灵魂儿真个脱离躯壳，留在三公主身边了。

en.t: as if he felt that his soul had truly slipped free of his body and remained beside the Third Princess.
